question: Who is the first Indian to have authored a published English novel?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.__

__
 
• **Chattopadhyay's** first novel was an English one,** Rajmohan's Wife **(1864) and he also started writing his **religious** and **philosophical **essays in English.
 
• **Vande Mataram** is a Bengali poem written by **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay** in the **1870s** and was first sung by **Rabindranath Tagore**.
 
• This poem became a popular marching song for **political activism** and the **Swadeshi movement in 1905**.
 
• Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's other novels include (all languages) - **Anandmath, Vande-Matram, Durgeshnandini, Kapalkundala, Devi Chaudhirani, etc.**

 **Jhumpa Lahiri**
 
 
Jhumpa Lahiri original name is **Nilanjana Sudeshna Lahiri.**

 
Born July 11, 1967, London, England.

 
Lahiri was born to **Bengali **parents from Kolkata her **father a university librarian** and her** mother a schoolteacher**.

 
Famous works - **Interpreter of Maladies, The Namesake, Unaccustomed Earth, In other Words, etc.**

 
 
 

 **Amitav Ghosh**
 
 
Amitav Ghosh was born on **July 11, 1956 Kolkata.**

 
He received a **B.A. 1976** and an **M.A. 1978** from the **University of Delhi.**

 
His first novel **The Circle of Reason** 1986.

 
Famous works- **Sea of Poppies, The Hungry Tide, The Shadow Lines, Gun Island, River of Smoke, etc.**

 
 
 

 **Rabindranath Tagore**
 
 
On **7 May 1861**, Rabindranath Tagore was born in his ancestral home in Kolkata to an **upper-class Bengali** family.

 
**Mahashri Devendra Nath** and **Sharda Devi **were his parents.

 
When he received the award in **1913** for his translation of his own work in Bengali, **Gitanjali,** he became the first **non-European** to receive the **Nobel Prize** for Literature.

 
Famous works- **Gitanjali, The Home and the World, Kabuliwala, The Post Office, Stray Birds.**
